p108_B2_missing_group.basis: The printed group has four visible coordinates and the overall stream has 135 slots against the advertised 136. Modeling one missing coordinate somewhere inside this short group is a stated source-motivated assumption. Its exact within-group position is not supplied by the page.
p108_B2_missing_group.primary_choice: D?AGD preserves every ordinary word without filling or changing any observed coordinate, leaving the final reference label unresolved. All five source-supported placements and their costs under the same explicit word constraint are retained; no unconditional unique geometry is claimed.
p108_B2_missing_group.diagnostic_constraint_limit: This is a lexical diagnostic, not independent ciphertext evidence. It preserves the first 66 positions of the selected readable frame while leaving the final reference position as found in each alternative.

prior_attribution_check.key_credit: Unchanged published Nov1–3 key with original provenance.

limits: A is a separate naval inquiry; only B1 and B2 are joined by the two-part source header and the split AUS/MILITAERDIENST wording.
A and B1 have native lengths 282 and 130 with no source edits. A recovers the visible final FX row omitted by earlier OCR, not a conjectural historical insertion.
B2 has 135 visible coordinates; its primary 136-coordinate model includes one explicitly missing source slot inside the four-letter DAGD group. All five within-group placements are retained.
The primary edited layers are identical to the raw layers under their stated frames: zero observed-coordinate substitutions and zero missing-coordinate fills.
RUDOLF occurs twice and is retained twice. Address, rank and routing abbreviations are not silently expanded.
The unresolved reference character has domain 027GQT in the selected frame. Decimal-only choices 027 require an additional numerical-field assumption, and none is selected.
Numerical labels, repeated names and message references remain literal. An inquiry or discharge instruction is not proof of arrival or completed discharge.
Exact re-encryption proves compatibility with the unchanged key and stated frame, not historical uniqueness. Prior readable personnel bodies and published key credit are preserved.
